_comment: The mad-hatter sheet is a pose sheet, not a direction x frame grid: row 2 is
front-facing poses, rows 1 and 3 are back-facing ones, and the facing drifts
across each row. So the cells are picked by hand. [row, col], 1-based.
Both diagonal groups in this sheet face RIGHT (row 2 cols 1-3 look toward the
viewer's right; row 3 cols 1-3 are backs turned right), so SE and NE come from
the sheet and SW and NW are the mirrors. The sheet has no true profile, so E
and W reuse the nearest diagonal.
